html:
I’ve been to Hyundai-Kia’s test center in Germany, and it’s very international. English has, unusually, risen to first official language, with German second and Korean third. At the other German OEMs and suppliers I’ve visited, there are few foreigners to begin with, German reigns supreme, and the Germans at these companies generally speak so-so English.

If you can’t or don’t want to speak German but still want to work in Germany, a foreign company there is one way to go.
